summary: The comment opposes broad cuts to the E‑Rate program, limits on consultant fees, federal control over classroom technology, a short comment period, and additional administrative burdens. The commenter opposes any sunset or restriction of the E‑Rate program, rejects limits on consultant compensation, and objects to screen‑time or instructional technology limits, while urging that new administrative requirements be scalable and not create barriers to participation.
